relationships.subject: Go6983
relationships.evidence_quote: Injection of Go6983 into TG significantly attenuated the expression of CGRP and Piezo2 in both the TG and whisker pads at 21 days after CCT operation

relationships.subject: Go6983
relationships.evidence_quote: Behavior tests of orofacial mechanical allodynia also revealed that the PKC inhibitor significantly alleviated the allodynia grade after the CCT operation on PODs 14 and 21 (Fig. 3i).

relationships.subject: ATP
relationships.evidence_quote: The administration of ATP successfully upregulated the expression of CGRP and SP in primary TG neurons (Fig. 4c).

relationships.subject: ATP
relationships.evidence_quote: ATP could also increase the expression level of Piezo2 and was revealed to be involved in the calcium signaling pathway.

relationships.subject: Piezo2
relationships.evidence_quote: Behavior tests revealed that knockdown of Piezo2 in whisker pads by LV-Piezo2 shRNA significantly ameliorated allodynia after the CCT operation on PODs 14 and 21 (Fig. 3j)

key_findings: Trigeminal root compression raises CGRP, SP and Piezo2 in TG and whisker pad; PKC inhibition and Piezo2 knockdown relieve allodynia.
Extracellular ATP upregulates CGRP/SP and Piezo2 in TG neurons via Ca2+ signaling.
